title: Forgetting the Words, Keeping the Sentence: code, derived data and results for token-level unlearning of toxic spans
description:
Code, derived data and per-run results for the paper "Forgetting the Words, Keeping the Sentence: Token-Level Unlearning of Toxic Spans in Large Language Models". The release contains the exact data split, majority-vote spans, the 120-word lexicon and occlusion-detector scores derived from the ToxicSpans dataset (Pavlopoulos et al., 2022), scripts that rebuild and verify them, and the measurements behind every table and figure for Qwen2.5-0.5B, TinyLlama v1.1 and OLMo-2-0425-1B.

Content warning: the data concerns abusive online comments, and the lexicon and logs contain offensive words. Model adapters and raw generations are not included.

Code: MIT licence. Derived data, results and figures: CC BY 4.0. The ToxicSpans source data is not redistributed and remains under CC0 1.0.
